in_marathi.name: Raghava
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Protector of the Universe
in_marathi.long_meaning: Raghava हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Raghava is a Sanskrit name which means 'Protector of the Universe'. It is derived from the word 'Raghu', which is the name of a legendary king in Hindu mythology. Raghava is also the name of the god Rama, who is considered to be an avatar of Vishnu and the ideal man. Raghava is a strong and courageous name, and it is often given to boys who are believed to have the potential to protect and defend their loved ones and their community.
